issue_context.title: BACKUP SQL Command returns size of 0
comments:
The root cause of the problem is that we get the total size via a key named `"Size"` in the summary collector:

https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/f7fdffc0b3a6ef0b83a97488c415479163371a29/executor/brie.go#L509-L510

...but we recorded the size with other keys, we can record the same data with key `"Size"` to solve the problem, at, for example, here:

https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/550c7d04debe59011b6dcbdca9982be8405dd39c/br/pkg/task/restore.go#L269

Test on v5.0.2, it works as expected
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/85682690/130001570-ab284925-d8e5-4ef0-a59b-f5559d0f698b.png)
BACKUP in v5.1.1: RESTORE in v5.1.1:
